Let \(N=\mathbb Z^3\), and consider the rays generated by
\[
u_0=(0,0,1),\quad u_1=(1,0,1),\quad u_2=(0,1,1),\quad u_3=(1,1,1),\quad u_4=(2,0,1).
\]
Let \(X\) be the smooth toric threefold over \(\mathbb C\) whose fan consists of the cones
\[
\langle u_0,u_1,u_2\rangle,\qquad
\langle u_1,u_2,u_3\rangle,\qquad
\langle u_1,u_3,u_4\rangle
\]
and all their faces. Write \(T\) for its dense torus and \(V(\sigma)\) for the closure of the torus orbit associated with a cone \(\sigma\). Set
\[
C_1=V(\langle u_1,u_2\rangle),\qquad
C_2=V(\langle u_1,u_3\rangle),\qquad
v=V(\langle u_1,u_2,u_3\rangle).
\]
The compact effective curve classes form \(\mathbb Z_{\geq0}[C_1]+\mathbb Z_{\geq0}[C_2]\). On the affine chart at \(v\), order the three invariant coordinate axes so that the first is \(C_1\), the second is \(C_2\), and the third is the remaining axis. Restrict equivariant parameters to the one-parameter subgroup having tangent weights \(s,2s,-3s\) on these axes, where \(s=c_1(\mathbb C_1)\in H^2_{\mathbb C^*}(\mathrm{pt})\), and then evaluate at \(s=1\). Every integral below means its \(T\)-equivariant virtual-localization value followed by this specialization.

For \(a,b\geq0\) with \(a+b>0\) and \(n\in\mathbb Z\), let \(P_n(X,a[C_1]+b[C_2])\) be the moduli space of stable pairs \(\mathcal O_X\to F\), where \(F\) is a compactly supported pure one-dimensional coherent sheaf, the cokernel is zero-dimensional, the fundamental cycle of \(F\) has class \(a[C_1]+b[C_2]\), and \(\chi(F)=n\). Purity means that every nonzero subsheaf has one-dimensional support. Use the usual stable-pairs virtual class defined by the fixed-determinant, trace-free self-Ext obstruction theory of the complex \([\mathcal O_X\to F]\); the torus-fixed loci are proper.

Let \(i_v:\{v\}\hookrightarrow X\), and take the unnormalized equivariant point class \(\gamma=i_{v*}(1)\). On each moduli space, let \(\mathbb F\) denote the universal sheaf on \(P_n\times X\), with projections \(\pi_P\) and \(\pi_X\). Define the insertion
\[
\tau_3=\pi_{P*}\!\left(\operatorname{ch}_3^T(\mathbb F)\cup\pi_X^*\gamma\right),
\]
where \(\operatorname{ch}_3\) is the degree-six component of the ordinary Chern character, with its usual \(1/3!\) normalization.

For independent formal variables \(p,Q_1,Q_2\), define
\[
\begin{aligned}
\mathcal Z(Q_1,Q_2;p)
&=1+\sum_{\substack{a,b\geq0\\a+b>0}}Q_1^aQ_2^b
\sum_{n\in\mathbb Z}p^n
\int_{[P_n(X,a[C_1]+b[C_2])]^{\mathrm{vir},T}}1,\\
\mathcal F(Q_1,Q_2;p)
&=\sum_{\substack{a,b\geq0\\a+b>0}}Q_1^aQ_2^b
\sum_{n\in\mathbb Z}p^n
\int_{[P_n(X,a[C_1]+b[C_2])]^{\mathrm{vir},T}}\tau_3.
\end{aligned}
\]
Thus the empty stable pair contributes \(1\) to \(\mathcal Z\) and \(0\) to \(\mathcal F\), and the single-insertion connected series is \(\mathcal F/\mathcal Z\).

Determine the explicit rational function of \(p\), identified through its formal Laurent expansion at \(p=0\), given by
\[
[Q_1^2Q_2]\,\frac{\mathcal F(Q_1,Q_2;p)}{\mathcal Z(Q_1,Q_2;p)}.
\]
</problem>
